topic: Describing My Ideal School Life(描述我理想的学校生活)
genre: 说明 / 记叙(describe your ideal school life: courses, activities, friends and feelings)
source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 1 Further Exploration:Describing an ideal school life(描述你理想的学校生活——课程、活动、人与感受)。
prompt_cn: 上外版必修一 Unit 1 写作任务。请用英语写一篇约100词的短文,描述你理想的学校生活,内容包括:① 理想的课程或学习方式;② 你想参加的校园活动或社团;③ 你希望拥有怎样的同学与师生关系;④ 这样的学校生活会给你怎样的感受。注意:用时态正确(现在/将来),句子地道、围绕中心。
prompt_en: Write a short passage of about 100 words describing your ideal school life. Include: 1) the courses or way of learning you would like; 2) the school activities or clubs you want to take part in; 3) what kind of classmates and teacher-student relationship you hope for; 4) how this school life would make you feel. Use tenses correctly (present / future) and keep every sentence on topic.
points: 理想课程/学习方式(In my ideal school, lessons would be …)
想参加的活动/社团(I would join …)
理想的同学与师生关系(My classmates would be … and teachers would …)
这样的校园生活带来的感受(In such a school, I would feel …)
model_essay: Everyone dreams of a perfect place to learn, and I often imagine my ideal school life. In my ideal school, lessons would be lively and creative, so that we could think freely instead of just memorising facts. After class, I would join a drama club and a reading group, where we share stories and perform on a real stage. My classmates would be kind and sympathetic, always ready to help one another, and our teachers would treat us as friends rather than judges. There would never be a shortage of warm smiles in the corridors. In such a school, I believe I would feel relaxed, confident and truly happy every single day.
model_translation: 每个人都梦想有一个完美的学习之地,我也常常想象自己理想的学校生活。在我理想的学校里,课程会生动而富有创意,让我们能自由思考,而不只是死记硬背。课后,我会加入戏剧社和读书会,一起分享故事、登上真正的舞台。我的同学会友善而有同情心,总乐于互相帮助;老师会把我们当朋友,而不是评判者。走廊里永远不会缺少温暖的笑容。在这样的学校里,我相信自己每天都会感到放松、自信、真正快乐。

rubric.criteria: 四要素齐全:理想课程 / 活动社团 / 同学师生关系 / 感受
围绕“理想学校生活”一个中心展开、句句相关、过渡自然
时态正确(现在/将来/过去将来)、词汇句型多样准确、语法基本无误
